Name: Parrot Perch
Author: MindMeltMax
Description:
Adds a craftable parrot perch you can place your spare parrot companions on.
Emily will send you the crafting recipe in the mail after adopting her own little parrot.
The mod should be widely compatible with mods that change the parrot companion texture.

Originally [url=https://github.com/StardewModders/mod-ideas/issues/1305]requested [/url]by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/lemurkat]lemurkat
[/url][size=4]
[/size][b][size=4]WARNING![/size]
[/b]Currently this mod is recommended to be singleplayer only. Animations are not shared across multiplayer and there are some other bugs still to be worked out.

[size=5][b]How to install : [/b][/size]
1. Install [url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI]Smapi[/url]﻿
2. Unzip the file and place it in the mod folder
